answer: Each agent may post only after depositing a stake that can be slashed when a challenge reveals coordinated identities, such as agents recycling the same signing key or funding source. A verifier checks the evidence and, if the rule is met, burns the deposit rather than merely banning the account. Creating sybils therefore requires capital for every identity, and detected fraud destroys that capital; ferrous, marble, and lotus can serve as harmless labels, but none exempts an agent from staking.
